title: Level 3 — Ikaros
subtitle: Solar encounter based on the Solar Probe+ power system design
briefing: Ikaros follows the Solar Probe+ design (Landis et al., AIAA 2008-5712): a 9.5 solar radii perihelion, 510 times the sunlight at Earth.
One trip, no second chances: Earth → Venus → gravity assist → Sun → samples → back to Earth.
Build the spacecraft with 500 M USD without exceeding the launcher's capacity. Anything marked ⚗ is theoretical.
During the encounter: fold the main array, retract the secondary one behind the shield, keep the cells below 120 °C and power above 482 W.
To make history: with the Ikaros kit ⚗ (mini reactor, HTS magnetic field and nanobots) a dive to 850,000 km from the Sun opens up, where no solar panel survives.
objectives: Reach the 9.5 R☉ perihelion and come out with the hull and power intact.
Collect at least 3,500 MB of corona data (memory holds 3,000 MB: you must downlink in time).

pv-cooled.name: Actively cooled photovoltaics
pv-cooled.description: The paper's solution: concentrator cells with a coolant loop and a retractable array. Lower mass and risk.

stirling.name: Stirling converter
stirling.description: The paper's alternative: ~26 % system efficiency, no flight heritage. It may fail.

fission-reactor.name: ⚗ Mini fission reactor
fission-reactor.description: Constant power without depending on the Sun. The paper rules out the nuclear option because of cost.

shield-cc.name: Carbon-carbon shield
shield-cc.description: Material of Parker Solar Probe's real shield.

shield-liquid-metal.name: ⚗ Liquid-metal shield
shield-liquid-metal.description: Spreads the heat: takes less damage, but weighs twice as much.

hts-field.name: ⚗ HTS magnetic field
hts-field.description: Deflects plasma from a CME. Consumes power.

nanobots.name: ⚗ Nanobot swarm
nanobots.description: Repairs the hull while the reserve lasts.

corona-sensors.name: Corona sensors
corona-sensors.description: Particle and field instruments, like Parker's.

sensors-capsule.name: ⚗ Sensors + return capsule
sensors-capsule.description: Adds a 450 kg capsule that returns with samples after the encounter.
